description: This file defines a PHPStan extension class that provides reflection for registry properties in the OpenCart system. It maps property names to their corresponding classes, determines if properties exist, and constructs appropriate PropertyReflection objects with types, including support for dynamic property resolutions based on naming conventions.

classes.name: RegistryPropertyReflectionExtension
classes.description: A PHPStan class extension that provides property reflection support for the Registry class in OpenCart, handling dynamic property types based on predefined mappings and naming conventions.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Checks if the Registry class has a specified property, either by default mapping or naming pattern.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns a PropertyReflection object for the specified property, constructing its type based on mappings or naming heuristics.

methods.name: convertSnakeToStudly
methods.description: Converts a snake_case string to StudlyCaps format, used for class name construction.
